steps.note: Create the RFQ event used for the resubmission scenario.
Configure the event as an RFQ with a pricing quote sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a line item so the quote sheet has a value to revise.
Commit a submission window that remains active for the revision.
Invite the QA vendor that will submit and revise the quote.
Publish the event so the vendor can quote.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Verify the initial vendor response was accepted.
Continue in the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Reopen the active quote sheet for the submitted event.
Verify the vendor portal shows the renewed submitted confirmation.
Verify the changed price is held in the submitted response.
